title: cost-optimization: autotune batching/caching defaults + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Priya Nair
description: This PR bundles three tightly-related cost-optimization efforts: 1) sensible defaults and autotune hooks for request batching and KV-prefix caching to reduce per-token cost without degrading latency SLOs; 2) quantization profile support and onboarding templates for safe model QC when applying 4-bit/8-bit quantization variants; and 3) a lightweight unit-economics (uecon) CLI and dashboard integration that surface expected cost/latency tradeoffs for common workloads. Motivation: customers commonly underutilize batching/cache opportunities and are hesitant to apply quantization because of uncertain quality regressions. This change provides default configs, an automated autotuner that recommends conservative profiles per-route, and tooling to estimate unit cost impact so SRE/ML engineers can make informed decisions. Checklist: - [x] Add batching/caching default config + policy layer - [x] Implement autotune orchestration (trial runs + safety gates) - [x] Add quant-profiles schema and onboarding docs - [x] Uecon CLI prototype + console integration - [x] Unit/integration tests and e2e perf canary - [x] Add docs and migration guide Links: Linear ENG-8421, ENG-8476; incident SUP-318 inspired conservative safety gates.

Tom Becker: Unit-econ numbers look plausible; request adding a model-specific baseline calc to the CLI so customers can reproduce results.
Priya Nair: Implemented model-baseline flag; updated CLI help and tests.

release_notes: Adds autotune service for batching/caching defaults, quantization profiles schema, and unit-economics tooling. Non-breaking; default autotune is conservative (1% traffic) and opt-out via runtime config. See docs/ops/autotune.md and docs/ops/quant-profiles.md for migration steps.
